policy: The production model changes only when a candidate beats the production baseline on the SAME held-out test scenes (mean Dice and false-positive rate), with calibration reported. Candidates are written to ml/checkpoints/candidates/ and never overwrite the baseline.

models.name: unet_oil_spill_best
models.architecture: SAROilSpillUNet (ml/models/unet.py): 4-level U-Net, 32-64-128-256-256 channels, bilinear upsampling, 1-channel VV input, sigmoid output

checkpoint.metadata_source: read from the checkpoint dict (keys epoch, val_dice, val_iou, val_precision, val_recall)

training_data.note: ml/datasets/radar_data/Radar_data is empty in the delivered repository; training cannot be reproduced without it.

hyperparameters.note: Taken from ml/training/train.py; epochs_run from the checkpoint. Whether the checkpoint was produced by exactly this script version cannot be verified (the training data and logs are not in the repository).

known_limitations: Large between-scene variance on the test set (Dice 0.015 to 0.848).

Inference on a 2025 Copernicus Sentinel-1 scene (data/sentinel1/INFERENCE_REPORT.md) and on 462 tiles in data/sentinel1/event_predictions produced no detections: possible domain shift between the dataset's preprocessing and live sigma0 dB inputs.
No look-alike discrimination: low-wind areas and biogenic films are not modelled.
Calibration of output probabilities has not been measured.
Train/validation patches may come from the same scenes (validation leakage) - cannot be checked without the dataset CSVs; run `python ml/training/train.py --dry-run` once the data is present.
Training preprocessing (per-patch z-score) differs from evaluation/inference preprocessing (whole-scene z-score).

evaluation_protocol.tiling: 256 px, stride 256, no overlap; uncovered right/bottom strips scored as negative
evaluation_protocol.aggregation: per-scene metrics, unweighted mean over 7 scenes

models.training_preprocessing: per-256px-patch z-score (ml/datasets/dataset.py); DIFFERS from the evaluation normalisation

inference_paths.ml/inference/real_scene_inference.py: whole-image z-score, 256 px tiles with 32 px overlap, reflect padding, overlap mean

verification.result: Independent NumPy re-implementation reproduces the stored PyTorch output data/sentinel1/copernicus_oil_probability.tif to max |diff| 8.8e-8 (float32 precision)
verification.real_2025_scene_behaviour: max probability 0.0377, 0 pixels >= 0.5 on copernicus_sigma0_test.tif (valid sigma0 dB input, -50.6..-11.8 dB)

candidates.guard: ml/training/run_guard.py (training cannot write the production checkpoint)
candidates.rule: A candidate (e.g. a 6-epoch run) is an experiment. It is recorded here only after test-scene evaluation with the SAME protocol, and replaces the baseline only if it improves mean Dice without worse false positives.

evaluated.name: six_epoch_experiment
evaluated.protocol: ml/experiments/six_epoch_protocol.json (seed 42, scene normalisation, augmentation, early-stopping patience 2)

validation.caveat: validation patches come from the same source scenes as training patches

evaluated.summary: Higher macro Dice and better on 6 of 7 scenes, but more false positives (pixel FPR 0.097 vs 0.036 macro), lower pooled Dice and clearly worse calibration; the pre-registered rule requires all criteria, so the frozen baseline stays.

fresh_evaluations.note: Measured in this project with ml/evaluation/run_eval.py on the 7 held-out scenes. The stored historical metrics in models[].test_metrics and ml/baseline/BASELINE_v1.json are retained unchanged; the fresh historic-protocol run reproduces them exactly (max |diff| 0.0).

baseline.leakage: validation is leaky (all 14 source scenes appear in both train and validation CSVs); test scenes share no files with training but their footprints overlap training scenes on other dates (see eval_baseline.json)
